title: gatewatch: constitution changed without explicit human-review evidence
description: Evidence: commit efee0fc1865b0862dee9fcb8d3bd37bc5bcd8358, docs/CONSTITUTION.md lines 1-142 (new file). Article IX requires any change to the constitution to receive explicit human review and not ride an auto-merged PR. The merged-history record contains no seed tracker reference or explicit human sign-off for this change; commit metadata alone does not establish the required review. Audit finding.

title: gatewatch: audit trigger mandate changed without explicit human-review evidence
description: Evidence: commit 013ab58b9f8b2f8bdb5562a786f23d87c7eee814, .warren/triggers.yaml lines 1-47 (new audit trigger entries, including gatewatch-patrol, ratchetwatch-patrol, and tastewatch-sample). Article IX requires changes to audit entries in .warren/triggers.yaml to receive explicit human review and not ride an auto-merged PR. The merged-history record contains no seed tracker reference or explicit human sign-off for this change; commit metadata alone does not establish the required review. Audit finding.

title: gatewatch: governance title claims workflow changes absent from diff
description: Evidence: commit efee0fc1865b0862dee9fcb8d3bd37bc5bcd8358, subject 'chore(governance): standardize CONSTITUTION.md and automated workflows'; git show --stat reports only docs/CONSTITUTION.md (142 insertions), and the full diff contains no workflow or automation-file change. Article I requires commit/PR subjects and descriptions to describe the diff truthfully. The subject claims automated workflow standardization that is absent from the merged diff. Audit finding.
